title: Make the thin boot switch read one config view and keep its tests hermetic
action: Fix the three findings in the review report .bee/mailbox/job-1794015590170-4062712-1/report-1.md. P3-b: the session-init hook must read dispatch.thin_peer_boot from the same merged main-checkout config (tracked config.json plus config.local.json) that herding/run.rs read_main_config reads, so an explicit false anywhere in that view turns BOTH the env layer and the hook off; add a test where false lives only in the main config.local.json and the hook runs from a linked worktree root. P3-a: the thin_peer tests in herding/run.rs and the session_init tests named in the report must not depend on the ambient process env (BEE_HERDING_WORKER, BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID, the four thin vars): build or filter the env explicitly. Prove it by running the full suite inside this herded worker WITHOUT unsetting any vars, and it must be green. P2: docs/config-reference.md row dispatch.thin_peer_boot must name only session-init, say no session is registered and prompt-context stays silent, matching the code and thin-peer-boot.md; update the concept with the one-config-view rule. Write tests first and watch them fail.
